The Defective Detective - Album 5: Serah Asks

How the Fox Did This Happen

"How the Fox did this happen?"

[Verse 1] Morning at Serah Solves Kin packed halfway down the hall Missing people Missing objects Searched-out rooms from wall to wall

Andy runs the intake desk “Missing Kin left Break-ins right” Keemaro and his three sons Stand amazed at every sight

Keeko whispers “This is normal?” Keewee says “I don’t think so” Junior writes “Very suspicious”

Serah mutters “Please don’t encourage them”

[Pre-Chorus] Kamira spreads the photos out Nessa checks another trace Coda maps the missing names Foxxie adds another case

Andy says “Seven more last night” Nothing stolen Everything searched

Serah looks up “That’s getting worse”

[Chorus] How the Fox did this happen? One case turned into ten Missing Kin and missing things Broken doors again and again How the Fox did this happen? Nothing taken Something sought Every answer leaves a question Every question leaves a knot

[Verse 2] Keemaro opens three new files Gold and Silver One near Platinum Same clean searches Same strange pattern Nothing worth a theft was gone

“We handle higher clients mostly”

Serah says “You mean rich”

Keemaro answers “Partly”

Then taps the Color rules

“The system chooses who gets through”

Serah says “Yeah I noticed”

Andy checks his list “We’ve got seven just like these”

Keemaro looks at him “Seven?”

Andy shrugs “I tagged similarities”

Serah turns “You did what?”

[Pre-Chorus] Different Colors Different doors Same strange searches Same old thread Rikka circles three addresses Kamira pins another spread

Nessa says “Timing overlaps” Coda answers “Some of it”

Then Serah sees one name

Lyra

[pause]

[Chorus] How the Fox did this happen? Different cases Same design Nothing stolen Something missing Every search too clean a line How the Fox did this happen? Who keeps looking? What for? Why? If Lyra knows what’s moving here Then why keep passing by?

[Verse 3] Keemaro says “She led us yesterday”

Serah folds her arms “Exactly”

“So she’s involved?”

“No Or she knows who is”

Andy raises one hand

“If she wanted you to stop Why lead you anywhere?”

[pause]

Serah looks at him

“Good question”

The front door opens

Yuki enters Tikka with supplies

Tikka sees the crowd

“Oh no”

Yuki smiles

“I brought money”

Serah says

“No”

Yuki answers

“I wasn’t asking”

[Break] Keemaro clears his throat

“I have a proposal”

Serah groans

“No”

“Our cases overlap You reach streets we cannot reach We reach doors your Colors don’t”

Serah stares

“I hate that”

Keemaro says

“So do I”

“I share my files You share yours”

Serah answers

“No alliance”

[pause]

Nobody listens

[Verse 4] Rikka grabs an empty table

“I take this one”

Kamira starts dividing folders Nessa plugs another screen Coda merges timelines Foxxie checks what Kin have seen

Andy sorts the intake piles

“High-level right Street cases left”

Keeko carries folders Keewee maps the wall Junior asks where he should stand

Andy says “Somewhere useful”

Yuki lifts her coin purse

“I have funds”

Serah points

“Stop helping”

[Final Chorus] How the Fox did this happen? How did rivals share a board? Gold and Red and mostly Orange Comparing every door How the Fox did this happen? No vote No command Serah says there’s no alliance While the alliance makes a plan

Missing people Missing objects Someone searching through it all Lyra somewhere out ahead And Kin still lining up the hall

Serah looks around and sighs

“I said NO alliance”

[Outro] Nobody stops

Andy hands her a folder

“New case”

Keemaro asks

“So we’re working together?”

Serah opens the file

“No”

[pause]

“Give me your cases.”
